text:
jess: Heads up — main is red after the poetry lock bump. Failing test looks like an HTTP retry behavioral change. CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3456

ci-bot: Job failed: tests/http/test_retry.py::test_retry_on_429 (exit code 1)

amit: @jess thanks. can you paste the top of the trace? I can try a quick bisect if it's transitive.

jess: here — reproduced locally:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 2 retries but got 3
../redwood/runtime/http/retry.py:47
requests.packages.urllib3.util.retry.RetryError: Too many retries
```

marco: My hunch: urllib3 semantics changed in 2.1.0 (Retry defaults / redirect handling). What did the lock bump update?

jess: poetry.lock diff shows: requests 2.30.0 -> 2.31.0 and urllib3 1.26.16 -> 2.1.0 (transitive).

sara: repro steps I used: `git checkout main && poetry install --no-dev && tox -e py39 -- tests/http/test_retry.py::test_retry_on_429` — fails the same locally.

amit: I'll bisect the lock changes: `git bisect start --bad main --good v0.41.2` then revert lock commits. If it's a transitive pin, bisect will show which bump introduced urllib3 2.1.0.

amit: quick update — bisect points to the lockfile commit from dependabot that updated requests -> 2.31.0 which pulled urllib3 2.1.0.

marco: OK. Two options: pin urllib3 to the older major in pyproject.lock (temp) or adjust our Retry usage to be explicit to be compatible with 2.1 semantics. Given time, pinning is faster.

jess: I'll open a hotfix PR to pin urllib3 to <2.0 for now and add a regression test that asserts retry count. PR will include:
```
# pyproject.toml
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
urllib3 = "<2.0"
```

sara: Also add a changelog note so we don't forget to revisit when we actually support urllib3 2.x.

amit: After pin PR, can someone trigger a full CI rerun? I'll keep an eye on any other libraries that changed behavior.

ci-bot: Manual rerun requested by jess — queued.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: all tests green on main (after merge of pin PR #789).

jess: Nice — thanks @amit @marco @sara. Follow-up: create a tiny issue to track upgrading to urllib3 2.x and list tests to validate.

marco: Filed issue #1342 with notes and a test matrix for urllib3 2.x.

jess: closing this thread. :thumbsup:
